reading.title: Arctic Ice Melting and Climate Change
reading.passage: The Arctic ice sheet is melting at an unprecedented rate due to global warming. Scientists have observed that the average temperature in the Arctic has increased twice as fast as the global average over the past few decades. This rapid melting is causing sea levels to rise and affecting marine ecosystems. Polar bears and other Arctic animals face habitat loss and food scarcity. Additionally, the loss of white ice reduces the Earth's ability to reflect sunlight, creating a feedback loop that accelerates further warming.

questions.q: According to the passage, how does Arctic warming compare to global warming?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '평균 기온이 지난 수십 년간 지구 평균보다 두 배 빠르게 증가했다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What is one consequence of Arctic ice melting mentioned in the passage?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 얼음 녹음으로 인해 해수면이 상승한다고 직접 언급되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the passage explain about the feedback loop?
options: White ice helps warm the planet
Loss of ice reduces sunlight reflection
questions.explanation: 백색 얼음이 햇빛을 반사하는 능력을 잃으면 더 빠른 온난화가 가속화된다는 피드백 루프가 설명되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has more positive effects than negative effects on human society'?

structure.intro: 자신의 입장을 명확히 제시하고 간단한 이유 2-3개를 언급하세요. (2-3문장)
structure.body1: 첫 번째 논거를 구체적인 예시와 함께 전개하세요. (4-5문장)
structure.body2: 두 번째 논거를 설명하고 반론에 대한 답변을 포함하세요. (4-5문장)
structure.conclusion: 입장을 재확인하고 더 넓은 의미의 마무리를 제시하세요. (2-3문장)

listening.title: Student Advising Session
listening.script: Student: I'm struggling with my course load this semester. I'm taking five classes and working part-time, and I'm not sure if I can manage everything. Advisor: That's a lot to balance. Let me ask you some questions. Which classes are most important for your major? Student: Well, organic chemistry and calculus are required for my engineering program, but I'm also taking general education electives. Advisor: I recommend focusing on the required courses first. You might consider dropping one elective to reduce your stress. Additionally, many students find it helpful to visit the tutoring center for chemistry and math. Student: That sounds reasonable. How much does tutoring cost? Advisor: It's free for all registered students. You can sign up online and schedule sessions at times that work for you. I also suggest reviewing your work schedule. Sometimes students can adjust their hours during heavy academic periods.

questions.q: What is the main problem the student is facing?
questions.explanation: 학생이 5개 과목을 수강하고 아르바이트를 하면서 모든 것을 관리할 수 없다고 말하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the advisor suggest the student do?
options: Drop one elective and use tutoring
questions.explanation: 조언자는 선택 과목 하나를 드롭하고 튜터링 센터를 이용할 것을 권장했습니다.

questions.q: How much does tutoring cost at this university?
questions.explanation: 조언자가 등록된 모든 학생을 위해 무료라고 명시적으로 말했습니다.
